capabilities: Edit CSS snippet descriptions in a modal
extras: Descriptions live in an @description comment in the CSS file, so they follow the snippet to other editors; external edits need 'Reload Snippets' to appear.
intentEvidence: A plugin to edit/display CSS snippet descriptions directly within the CSS snippets menu.
problem: Obsidian's CSS snippets menu shows only snippet names, so users cannot tell what a snippet does without opening its file.
summary: Plugin that adds editable descriptions to CSS snippets, stored as header comments in the snippet file itself.
